data.long_meaning: Asfaque is a Hindu name derived from Persian origins, meaning conqueror or victorious. It is a powerful and strong name that symbolizes courage and the ability to overcome obstacles. The name Asfaque carries the meaning “Conqueror, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Urdu, Bengali. Parents who choose Asfaque usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
